description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that ensures request idempotence. The client generates this token. It must be unique across requests. The token is case-sensitive and can contain up to 64 ASCII characters.
The name of the target instance.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 访问端点所在的专有网络ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the endpoint is located.
